name: Prinrit Local SEO Auditor
author: prinrit

sections.description:
Prinrit Local SEO Auditor provides permanent local SEO essentials for WordPress.

Free features:

  • Homepage SEO title and meta description
  • Per-page and per-post SEO titles and descriptions
  • Same-site canonical URL controls
  • Social sharing metadata and image controls
  • WordPress-native noindex handling
  • Connected Organization, WebSite and WebPage schema
  • A local audit for up to 200 published posts and pages
  • Compatibility protection when another major SEO plugin is active
  • No account, payment method, tracking, usage quota or feature expiry

The local audit reads only this WordPress database and makes no external requests. Prinrit Local SEO Auditor does not collect visitor information or send site content to a third party.

Optional Pro services are provided through a separately hosted plugin and platform. Current monthly plans are Core Licence at ฿259, Care at ฿890 and Managed Growth at ฿1,999. You can compare optional plans. Choosing not to upgrade never changes or expires the Free features listed above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prinrit-local-seo-auditor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate Prinrit Local SEO Auditor.
  3. Open Prinrit SEO Auditor in the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Review the homepage metadata and run the local page audit.
  5. Edit any post or page to configure its optional SEO fields.

Only one plugin should own document titles, descriptions, canonical URLs and schema. If SEO Intelligence Pro, Rank Math, Yoast SEO, All in One SEO or SEOPress is active, Prinrit Local SEO Auditor pauses its public metadata output to avoid duplicates. When upgrading to Pro, activate Pro first, confirm that the Free output is paused, and then deactivate the Free plugin. Compatible page-level SEO fields are retained locally.
sections.faq:
Is the Free edition time limited?

No. Every feature included in this plugin remains available without an account, payment method, licence key, usage quota or expiry date.

Does it send visitor or page data elsewhere?

No. The plugin has no analytics tracker and its audit runs locally inside WordPress.

Can it run with another SEO plugin?

It can remain installed, but public metadata output pauses while SEO Intelligence Pro or another supported SEO plugin is active. This avoids duplicate titles, canonicals and schema. After activating Pro, you may safely deactivate the Free plugin; the shared page-level SEO fields remain in WordPress.

Does it guarantee rankings?

No. It provides technical metadata tools. Search visibility also depends on content quality, crawlability, relevance, authority and competition.
